meta.title: Pulse — The complete health app for your Garmin
meta.description: Keep wearing your Garmin. Get a complete picture of your health every morning — recovery, strain, and sleep, turned into action.

hero.headline: Keep wearing your Garmin. Get a complete picture of your health.
hero.subheadline: Pulse turns the data your Garmin already collects into recovery, strain, and sleep insight you can act on every morning.

image.alt: Trail runner at sunrise checking a sport watch on their wrist

howItWorks.headline: Three steps from sign-up to insight

steps.title: Connect your Garmin
steps.description: One-tap OAuth with Garmin Connect. No new device, no syncing dance, no extra wearable on your wrist.

steps.title: We pull your last 30 days
steps.description: Pulse imports your Body Battery, HRV, sleep stages, and training load history so the app is useful from day one.

steps.title: Open Pulse every morning
steps.description: Recovery, strain, and sleep on the home screen — distilled from your Garmin into the one view you'll actually check.

features.headline: Your Garmin data, finally working for you

items.title: Recovery, surfaced
items.description: Body Battery, HRV, and sleep distilled into a single recovery score on the home screen — not buried five taps deep.

items.title: Strain that means something
items.description: Today's training load against your recommended target. A clear answer to 'should I push hard or back off?' — not a raw number.

items.title: Sleep clarity
items.description: Stages, sleep debt, and last night versus your personal baseline. See drift before it costs you a workout.

items.title: No new hardware
items.description: Works with every Garmin watch that reports HRV and sleep — Forerunner, Fenix, Epix, Venu, Vivoactive. Wear what you already wear.

items.title: Trends, not snapshots
items.description: Your last 30 / 90 / 365 days of recovery and strain on one chart. Spot the patterns a daily widget can't show you.

items.title: Your data, your control
items.description: Read-only Garmin OAuth. Export or delete everything in one click. No third-party sharing. Ever.

comparison.headline: How Pulse compares
comparison.subheadline: Pulse: $9.99/mo, runs on your Garmin. Garmin Connect: free, but recovery is buried. Whoop: $30/mo and a second strap.

socialProof.headline: The future of health is continuous

testimonials.quote: Continuous data from wearable sensors provides a rich, granular, high-definition view of each person's health — and that changes everything.

testimonials.role: Cardiologist, founder of Scripps Research Translational Institute, author of Deep Medicine

testimonials.quote: The opportunity with sensors, data, and AI is to move us from being intermittent and reactive to being continuous and proactive.
testimonials.name: Dr. Daniel Kraft
testimonials.role: Founder of NextMed Health, faculty chair for Medicine at Singularity University

testimonials.quote: P4 medicine — predictive, preventive, personalized, participatory — is proactive instead of reactive. It's about wellness, not just disease.
testimonials.name: Dr. Leroy Hood
testimonials.role: Co-founder of the Institute for Systems Biology, pioneer of systems medicine
